title: Short numeric status list
rationale: Tests the exact failure mode: independent unpunctuated lines should become one utterance with ordinary sentence boundaries.
originalText:
10 voices available
2 backends installed
1 hotkey configured
0 errors reported
baselineText: 10 voices available 2 backends installed 1 hotkey configured 0 errors reported
expectedPreparedText: 10 voices available. 2 backends installed. 1 hotkey configured. 0 errors reported.

title: Lowercase action lines
rationale: Tests whether a list-like block without capitalised starts should receive the same period-and-space treatment.
originalText:
install Pulse Reader
select the Kokoro backend
press the global hotkey
listen to the result
baselineText: install Pulse Reader select the Kokoro backend press the global hotkey listen to the result
expectedPreparedText: install Pulse Reader. select the Kokoro backend. press the global hotkey. listen to the result.

title: Address ending in a UK postcode
rationale: Tests line boundaries separately from postcode pronunciation; no punctuation is appended after the final postcode.
originalText:
Pulse Reader House
14 Market Street
London
SW1A 1AA
baselineText: Pulse Reader House 14 Market Street London SW1A 1AA
expectedPreparedText: Pulse Reader House. 14 Market Street. London. SW1A 1AA

title: Sentence split across physical lines
rationale: Tests the safety boundary: grammatical continuation cues must keep wrapped prose flowing exactly as before.
originalText:
This guide explains how to
select a voice and preview it
without interrupting the application.
baselineText: This guide explains how to select a voice and preview it without interrupting the application.
expectedPreparedText: This guide explains how to select a voice and preview it without interrupting the application.
